public_rationale: The evidence does not settle this compound claim. The independent capacity estimate uses a different denominator and period. limitations: Global compute estimates cannot substitute for hyperscaler customer allocations.

public_payload.normalized_proposition: Hyperscaler capacity is mostly used by OpenAI and Anthropic, which burn billions and have no apparent plan to stop.

statement.excerpt: Said capacity is mostly taken up by OpenAI and Anthropic, two companies that burn billions of dollars and do not appear to have an answer for how they might stop.

from_speaker: Said capacity is mostly taken up by OpenAI and Anthropic
do not appear to have an answer for how they might stop
our_interpretation: Read 'said capacity' as operational AI computing capacity associated with the Microsoft, Google and Amazon investments discussed immediately before this sentence.
Read 'mostly' as more than half of that capacity, measured consistently across providers.

Use January–March 2026, the latest completed reporting quarter before publication, for the ongoing capacity and financial observations. This reporting convention does not establish that 'billions' means billions per quarter.
Read 'no apparent answer' as no publicly substantiated route to ending the losses. A commercial strategy is relevant, but its existence does not establish that it will succeed.
The financial language does not identify whether 'burn' means cash consumption, operating losses or net losses. No accounting basis can safely be assigned to that component.
criteria.support_condition: Comparable allocation records show that the two labs together used more than half of the specified operational capacity, financial records establish ongoing multibillion-dollar cash consumption on a clearly defined period and basis, and contemporary public plans provide no substantiated route to ending it.
criteria.contradiction_condition: Comparable allocation records show a combined share of half or less, or matching financial records disprove the claimed cash consumption. A substantiated contemporary route to ending losses would challenge the final component; an unsupported profitability target would not suffice.
